content: Our raw data consists of 270K recipes and 1.4M user-recipe interactions (reviews) scraped from Food.com, covering a period of 18 years (January 2000 to December 2018). See tab:int-stats for dataset summary statistics, and tab:samplegk for sample information about one user-recipe interaction and the recipe involved.
